notes: Customer must use the bank account initially registered with the business.

notes: Documentation recommends attempting the transaction again after some time.

notes: Customer must complete a fresh payment request within the specified time limit.

notes: Documentation suggests making another payment attempt.

description: The payment could not be completed as the customer exceeded the time limit for payment processing. This time limit is typically 10 minutes unless otherwise specified.
notes: Customer must complete the payment within the specified time limit.

description: There was a downtime on our partner bank due to which the payment has failed.
notes: Partner bank downtime must be addressed; multi-terminal routing may help.

description: The payment could not be completed because the customer cancelled the transaction or pressed the back button during the payment processing period.
notes: Customer can attempt the payment again or complete it later.

description: The payment was declined by the customer’s bank, resulting in the transaction being unsuccessful.
notes: Customer should contact their bank or try another card.

description: The payment did not go through because the customer’s bank account did not have enough funds to complete the transaction.
notes: Customer needs an adequate account balance before retrying.

description: The payment was unsuccessful as the card was not activated or enabled by the customer for online transactions.
notes: Customer must enable online transactions through their Card Control page.

notes: Customer must enter the correct OTP and complete authentication.
